title: Paani Par Tairti Eentein 😱 | Ramappa Mandir | Mandir Ke Rahasya Ep 1
setting: Ramappa (Rudreshwara) temple, Palampet, Mulugu district, Telangana, India; 13th-century Kakatiya era, sandstone temple with black dolerite sculptures beside Ramappa lake
description:
800 saal purane Ramappa mandir ki eentein paani mein doobti nahi, tairti hain!
1213 mein bana ye mandir apne shilpkar ke naam par hai, aur iski neev mein ret bhari gayi thi — bhookamp ke jhatke sokhne ke liye. 2021 mein UNESCO World Heritage bana.

#ramappatemple #MandirKeRahasya #telangana
